description: The one shape every capability CLI prints for a failing command under --json, on stderr, and the one problem record inside it. `<tool>` is the tool's own schema namespace (matrix, ix, recon). A consumer tolerates keys and problem kinds it does not know: both sets grow.

error.kind: a kind from exit-codes.json, or one of the tool's own
error.complete: false when checking stopped before every problem was found; fix these and check again
error.problems: a list of problem records; empty when the error has none
error.details: a mapping of the error's own facts; empty when it has none

problem.path: the offending key, dotted from the document root
problem.kind: a kind from problem_kinds, or one of the tool's own
problem.allowed: the legal values where the set is closed; empty otherwise
problem.got: what was written, when it is a scalar; null otherwise
problem.source: the file the problem is in, when that is not the document the command was given

problem_kinds.yaml_syntax: the file is not valid YAML or frontmatter
problem_kinds.schema_unsupported: the document names a schema this tool does not read
problem_kinds.wrong_shape: a value has the wrong type or structure
problem_kinds.unknown_key: a key the schema does not have
problem_kinds.invalid_value: a value of the right type that the schema refuses
problem_kinds.name_unknown: a name or type URL that is not registered or defined

warning.description: Warnings travel inside the command's own --json document as `warnings: [problem]`, never only as prose on stderr.
